restoration_note: This teaching maps cosmic time as a contrast between the unmeasurable Father/Mother and the countable, bounded ages of natural process — Hyle's slow movement through five elements → trees → fruits → five worlds, against the simultaneous depiction of the divine builders and the four-fold sequence ending in the 1468-year fire. Restorations are concentrated where formulaic language anchors the fill: the recurring ⲭⲛ̄ ⲙ̄ⲡⲥⲏⲩ ('from the time'), ⲦⲦⲙⲁϩ-N ⲡⲉ ordinal series, ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ̄ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ / ⲡⲁⲛⲁⲣⲉⲁⲥ titles, the ⲕⲁⲓⲣⲟⲥ ⲙⲛ̄ ⲭⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ doublet, and the typological transition formula ⲧⲍⲉ ⲍⲱϩ ⲁⲛ ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉ. Most editor proposals were accepted; ⲧⲉⲥⲕⲉ at gap 23 was redirected from 'ordering' to 'delay/sojourn' since ⲉⲥⲕⲉ recurs throughout the page meaning a span of waiting (cf. line 12 ⲟⲩⲉⲥⲕⲉ ⲉⲛⲁϣⲱⲥ). Editor's ⲧⲉⲧⲛ ('you pl.') at gap 228 was rejected as contextually impossible in the cosmic-fire passage. Large mid-line lacunae of 15+ chars without partial traces or formulaic anchors (gaps 84, 86, 88, 89, 90, 147, 157, 199, 215, 245, 246, 251, 270) are honestly unrestorable. Sections 1488–1500, 1503–1507, 1520–1521 lack apparatus entries and surrounding context entirely, leaving most {103}–{132} unrestorable.
